Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.9 (4)
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
A small build update for 0.9 with a number of bug fixes.

- Fixed some pages not loading in webtoon reader
- Improved webtoon reader memory usage (hopefully fixes crash after reading multiple chapters)
- Fixed crash when searching anywhere in the macOS app
- Various other bug fixes

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.9
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- OCR dictionary support (iOS 18+): import Yomitan-compatible dictionaries in the app and look up words while reading.
- Suwayomi built-in source: read and track from a Suwayomi instance, just like Komga and Kavita.
- Auto scroll for webtoon reader: enable and press the play button to scroll without touching your device.
- Fixed CloudFlare handling: CloudFlare issues that caused external sources to break should be resolved.
- Overall performance improvements: the library loads much faster (@Amqx), and the webtoon reader was improved.
- Source stability fixes and disable option: the issue where sources were causing the app to crash should not happen again, and now you can even disable a source that is broken until it receives an update.
- Many more things: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.8.4
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- Fixes for iOS 27: fixed settings pages freezing the app, along with other minor visual issues.
- Improved backup restore time: restores should now take seconds instead of minutes. (@Amqx)
- Failed download page retrying: less chance of missing pages in downloaded chapters from sources with aggressive rate limits. (@pxseu)
- New chapter notifications (experimental): when Aidoku refreshes in the background, notification(s) of new chapters should be sent if enabled. (@Zareix)
- Various other bug fixes and small features: see [the website](<https://aidoku.app/release-notes/>) for a more complete list.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.8.3
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- New migration flow: view series details and optionally copy data instead of completely migrating.
- Kavita API key login: in addition to OIDC and basic auth, use an API key if it works better for you.
- Continuous with gaps reading mode: like the Webtoon mode, but with gaps between pages.
- Fixed tracker search bar: should show again on iOS 26.4+.
- Improved double page reader: new page offset setting and double page handling fixes.
- Various other bug fixes and small features: see [the website](<https://aidoku.app/release-notes/>) for a more complete list.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.8.2
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- Filter groups: save library filter configurations to categories library items.
- Saved source searches: save and load search text and filter configurations in sources.
- MangaBaka tracker: log in and track items with mangabaka.org.
- Hide bars on swipe setting: automatically dismiss bars in the reader after swiping to the next page.
- Missing source list indicator: displays a warning if a source was removed from a source list and will no longer receive updates.
- Improved text reader (experimental): now with a paged reading style and font configuration for text-only chapters.
- Scanlator affinity: prefers next chapters from the scanlator you're already reading.
- Komga/Kavita mirror list option and various source improvements
- Various bug fixes and stability improvements: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.8.1
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- Pinned sources should stay pinned
- Error when restoring chapters from backup resolved
- Insights page more accurately determines chapter read count
- Kavita source login issues resolved
- Lots of other fixes (30+)! Check [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.8
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- New icon: updated for liquid glass.
- Fluid transitions: Aidoku now fits in with more iOS 26 apps, letting you swipe to close the reader and other views.
- Insights: reading time is now tracked (starting from this update), and you can see reading statistics in the insights page.
- Library improvements: list mode, additional filter options, persistent filters, and improved multi-select.
- Auto reader background color option: determine the reader background based on page color.
- Live Text support: copy text and use Apple's built in image text translation feature by pressing the live text icon in the bottom right corner of page images.
- Incognito indicator: a noticeable banner at the top now reminds you when reading history won't be tracked.
- Fixed library refresh: should be more stable/consistent now, as I've seen a lot of people with issues recently.
- Lots of other things! Check [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.7.3
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- Background downloading (iOS 26+): feel free to switch off the app while your downloads (and library refresh) complete.
- Download compression: downloading should now be significantly faster and result in less storage usage by default, and you can now export downloaded chapters as cbz files.
- Automatic backups: Aidoku can now schedule periodic backups in the background just in case something happens and you need to restore old data.
- Built-in Kavita source and tracker (just like Komga).
- New search tab: redesigned look, now with filter options and search history.
- Local files improvements: metadata can now be parsed from ComicInfo.xml files (and downloads from other sources now save this).
- Download badges: see how many downloaded chapters you have, next to the unread badge.
- Many bug fixes: various iPadOS issues, Komga PDF pages, download crashes, auto tracking logic, etc.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.7.2
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- New settings tab: now with better organization and search support.
- Wide page isolation and splitting: when using the double page layout (e.g. on iPads), wide pages can be detected and isolated, and when using the single page layout, there’s a new option to automatically split into two pages.
- Komga tracker: automatically tracks reading history for Komga sources, including page progress in individual volumes.
- Library refresh progress bar: when a library refresh starts, there’s now a better indicator of the progress towards completion.
- Backup user settings: the content that’s backed up can now be configured, and allows including user settings.
- Other features and fixes: content rating tags in search results, an invert tap zones option, a Bangumi tracker, relative dates for chapter releases, and many bug fixes!

The latest ipa is `Aidoku.ipa`, build 0.7.2 (3), up to commit be6089aefa58d4a2bd77c0c93dcad40deb19bbf6.

Aidoku/Aidoku.name: v0.7.1
Aidoku/Aidoku.body:
- Tap zones: tap the sides of the screen to switch pages without needing to swipe.
- Download manager: view and read all downloaded chapters, and see more detailed storage usage.
- Image upscaling (experimental): download ML image upscaling models to improve low quality images while reading. Note that this can increase the time it takes for images to load, especially for slower/older devices, and is still very much an experimental feature.
- Keyboard support: use a connected keyboard (or if you’re just using macOS) to turn pages.
- Custom series covers: select from alternate covers if a source provides them, or upload your own cover images.
- Rewritten History tab: it should hopefully look pretty much the same… but be a bit less buggy! The excessive stuttering, long loading times, and needless reloading in some cases were fixed.
- Other features and fixes:
    - Manual page image reload option (if a page loads incorrectly)
    - Uploading local files should actually work now
    - Tracker searching now has a toggle-able filter for NSFW results
    - …and more!
